student: intermediate Python/pandas experienced, first Streamlit; do not equate global level to library familiarity

units.name: Streamlit 文件上传与脚本重运行
units.project_task: 搭一个最小页面，用 st.file_uploader 上传 CSV，用 pandas 读入并显示表头和行数。

units.name: pandas 列校验与逐行规则验证
units.project_task: 编写 validate(df) 函数：检查必需列，解析 date、校验 room/visits/capacity/open_minutes/occupied 约束，返回有效数据与被排除行数。
useful_new_skill_signals: invalid-row count and preserving valid zeros

units.name: Streamlit 日期区间与多选控件
units.project_task: 添加起止日期（两端包含）与房间多选（默认全部），实现筛选函数。
useful_new_skill_signals: inclusive bounds/default/empty selection only when expressly taught

units.name: 筛选后数据的加权使用率聚合
units.project_task: 写 compute_metrics(filtered)：返回 visits 总和、occupied 总和、加权使用率（%保留1位小数）。
useful_new_skill_signals: weighted ratio from aggregate totals or filtered consistency
generic sum alone is prerequisite support, not sufficient new learning

units.name: groupby 汇总与 Streamlit 条形图
units.project_task: 对 filtered groupby room 求 sum(visits)，非空时 st.bar_chart 显示。
useful_new_skill_signals: pandas groupby alone is already-known support

units.name: 空结果的安全展示
units.project_task: 在指标与图表前加入空数据与错误状态判断，显示“—”和提示，阻止除零。
useful_new_skill_signals: empty-data/error guard with recoverable Streamlit display
message/render branch and no unsafe metric/chart on empty data

source_truthfulness_requirements: real observed title and source URL; own identity/provenance
only own page/catalog/strict bound-video summary may confirm concepts
actual chapter URLs/timestamps only; no invented teaching or chapter times
source page language and media language distinguished
login/payment/region restrictions disclosed, not called invalid; generic error/shell pages not normal recommendations
coverage_counters_keep_separate: units with useful new project-relevant skill evidence
whole unit complete; never count a partial card as complete
forbidden_donation: generic Python/pandas full introductions replacing first Streamlit skills
query/title tokens, navigation, related videos, prerequisites, TODO or cumulative code treated as own teaching
weighted sum ratio inferred from mean-of-rates or generic sum
st.bar_chart inferred from Matplotlib/Plotly chart lesson
0 visits removed; empty rooms interpreted as all; missing required literal comparisons silently filled
source_links_policy: No new link requests/playback tests by reviewer; format/ownership and previously fetched public metadata are audit evidence. Unverified access remains unknown.
production_claim_rule: Truthful partial recommendations and known unmet project constraints must be visible. Source integrity and meaningful per-unit usefulness must be assessed separately from result counts. No live result is asserted before retained final job evidence is reviewed.
